programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ciberseguridad e Inteligencia de Datos

ects: 60 (RUCT: 48 obligatorios + 6 prácticas + 6 TFM, 0 optativos; programme page also states '60 ECTS')

tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND for 2026-27 — ULL has not published 2026-27 master fees (matrícula page says info 'available shortly'). Canary Islands public prices are set by Decreto 177/2022 (prorrogado 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26): máster NO habilitante, 1ª matrícula, 12.45–15.15 EUR/crédito depending on grado de experimentalidad (60 ECTS => approx. 747–909 EUR). tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (Decreto 177/2022 prorrogado); 2026-27 rates NOT PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND / apparently none — Decreto 177/2022 (Canarias) contains no differential price for extranjeros no comunitarios o no residentes; all rates apply uniformly. Recorded as 'no differential rate found in the decree', not as a positive university statement.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT, 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0, i.e. none built into the title). Applicant level: the programme's 'Acceso, admisión y matrícula' page states no complementos de formación; it defines an access profile (Grado en Informática, Telecomunicación, Matemáticas, Física, Estadística o afines with computing/maths at least at first-year-engineering level) and requires accredited English B1 — 'para acceder a este máster será requisito indispensable la acreditación de un nivel B1 de inglés'. No credit-recognition/advanced-standing statement for a 300-ECTS degree was found.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. Published 2026-27 calendar (record as 2026-27, not shifted): admisión condicionada open until 13 May 2026; ordinary applications 9–16 June 2026; extraordinary round 25–27 August 2026 if places remain.
notes: RUCT code confirmed from output/ruct-detail.jsonl / RUCT detail page, not from the programme page (the ULL page does not print a código RUCT). Title is healthy in the register (renewed accreditation 29/10/2025), so a Sept-2027 intake is plausible but not itself confirmed. Semipresencial modality is relevant: it is not a fully online title.

programme_name: NEGATIVE FINDING — la Universitat Oberta de Catalunya no ofrece un máster universitario específico de Inteligencia Artificial
official_status: NEGATIVE FINDING CONFIRMED — no such official title exists. A RUCT term query for 'inteligencia artificial' (accent-stripped, fresh session, all pages) returns no row for Universitat Oberta de Catalunya. UOC's own AI landing page lists only a 'Máster de FP de Inteligencia Artificial y Big Data' (vocational FP, awarded via UOC-FJE, NOT a máster universitario) plus microcredenciales/cursos; its AI-adjacent official masters are titled Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería Informática and Ciberseguridad y Privacidad.
ruct_url: N/A — none exists. Nearest UOC official titles: Ciencia de Datos RUCT 4316294 (https://www.educacion.gob.es/ruct/estudio.action?codigoCiclo=SC&codigoTipo=M&CodigoEstudio=4316294&actual=estudios), Ingeniería Informática RUCT 3500127, Ciberseguridad y Privacidad RUCT 4317173
notes: Independently re-sourced. Two lines of evidence agree: (1) RUCT register — .masters-search/spain/ruct.py 'inteligencia artificial' returns 40+ titles including UDIT 4318526, UIE 4318468, Universidad de León 4318450, UPF Erasmus Mundus 4318493 and La Rioja 4318615, but zero UOC rows; (2) UOC's own uoc.edu AI programme index, which offers no máster universitario in AI. Caveat on method: the ruct.py '--universidad' mode returned 0 rows for both 'Oberta de Catalunya' and 'Universitat Oberta de Catalunya', so the university-name filter appears not to work in this environment and was NOT relied on; the title-term query and the university's own page carry the finding. Also note UOC's 'Máster de FP' naming is easy to mistake for an official master — it is vocational training, and 'Máster de Formación Permanente' would likewise be a título propio.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de la Seguridad Informática e Inteligencia Artificial
official_status: máster universitario (official; RUCT estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Nivel MECES 3, Máster RD 822/2021, verificado 28/04/2016, BOE 24/10/2017 y 07/06/2022, acreditación institucional favorable 05/05/2026)
ects: 60 (RUCT: 36 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 9 TFM, 0 prácticas; URV fact sheet also states '60 ECTS')
modality: Presencial / Virtual — the URV fact sheet offers both and the student chooses at enrolment (40 places: 20 presencial + 20 virtual). CONFLICT (minor): guiadocent.urv.cat ensenyament 3865 shows 'Modalitat d'impartició: Presencial' only. The programme's own Informació acadèmica page describes the virtual track as asynchronous Moodle delivery with 75% continuous assessment + 25% individual videoconference interview, so the fact sheet is the fuller statement.
language_of_instruction: "Anglès" (URV fact sheet, field Idioma). Corroborated by the admission page: 'the master's degree is taught entirely in English', with an English B2 entry requirement (waived for native English speakers or those educated in English).
tuition_total_eur: EUR 2,913 for a non-EU/non-resident student for the full 60-ECTS programme (2026-27 rates), vs EUR 1,308 for EU/EEA/Swiss/Andorran students or residents in Spain. Add EUR 218.15 'Taxa de trajectòria acadèmica', charged at first enrolment to holders of a degree obtained outside the EU — so approx. EUR 3,131 all-in for this candidate.
non_eu_surcharge: YES, explicit and substantial. Verbatim: '1308€ (preu curs 2026-27)* per a estudiants de la UE, Islàndia, Noruega, Liechtenstein, Suïssa i Andorra* o residents a Espanya. Resta d'estudiants: 2.913 €' — i.e. a non-EU non-resident pays 2.23x the EU price. Plus '*Si has obtingut la titulació fora de la UE, en la primera matrícula s'aplicarà la Taxa de trajectòria acadèmica de 218,15 €.' NOTE: per Catalonia's Decret de preus, a long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status, so this candidate pays the 'Resta d'estudiants' rate.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT for the title (RUCT 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is null, not 0 — the register does not carry the row). Applicant level: the URV admission page states no complementos/complements de formació; it lists access degrees as 'Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Telecommunications or related field' (or the old Technical Engineering equivalents) plus English B2. A Software Engineering degree is squarely inside that profile. No advanced-standing / credit-recognition statement for a 300-ECTS degree was found on these pages.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. Published 2026-27 calendar (marked as 2026-27, not shifted): this programme follows URV 'Calendar B' — 1st and 2nd phases combined 2 March–14 May 2026; 3rd phase 15 May–7 July 2026; 4th phase 8 July–9 September 2026. CONFLICT: a search-index snippet of a URV page gave a different 2026-27 pattern (1st period 17 Nov–17 Dec 2025, 2nd 8 Apr–7 May 2026); the per-degree calendar page fetched directly is the primary source and is the one recorded. No non-EU-specific early round is stated on the calendar page.
notes: RUCT code 4315875 is printed on URV's own Informació acadèmica page — confirmed from the programme site, not just from the register. Register health is good (institutional accreditation renewed 05/05/2026), so a Sept-2027 intake is plausible. This is one of the few records in this batch where the non-EU price is published as an explicit second tariff rather than left to the decree.

institution: CEV — Escuela Superior de Comunicación, Imagen y Sonido (private, part of the AD Education group since 2019)
official_status: NOT a máster universitario — título propio / private-school certificate. CEV is a private vocational (FP) school, not a university, so it cannot award an official máster universitario. No RUCT row exists for CEV or for this title; the only 'Máster Universitario en Producción Musical' in the register is UNIR's (RUCT 3500676), a different institution. CEV's own pages say its qualifications are 'homologados por el Ministerio de Educación y Formación Profesional' — that homologation covers its Grado Medio/Grado Superior FP cycles (e.g. Técnico Superior en Sonido para Audiovisuales y Espectáculos), NOT the 'máster', and the words 'máster universitario', ANECA, RUCT and BOE appear nowhere on the site. Consequence for this candidate: no PhD access, no MECES level 3, and ineligible for public postgraduate scholarships.
ects: NOT FOUND — no ECTS figure published on cev.com; the programme is described in clock hours, not ECTS, which is itself consistent with a non-official title
modality: NOT FOUND on the primary site (presencial in Madrid is implied by the campus-based page title 'Máster en Producción Musical Madrid', but no explicit modalidad statement was readable)
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — no 'idioma de impartición' statement anywhere on cev.com. Spanish is the overwhelmingly likely medium (Madrid campus, Spanish/Catalan site) but that is an inference, not a sourced fact, and is NOT recorded as a value.
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND from a primary source. Aggregator listings (educaweb, emagister, docenzia) state EUR 7,245 for 1,200 hours; per the brief these may be used to discover but never to state a fact, and cev.com publishes no price that could be read.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — cev.com states no differential price for non-EU students. Silence is recorded as NOT FOUND, not as 'no'.
complementary_credits_required: N/A at title level (no RUCT row can exist for a non-official title). Applicant level: cev.com states generally that 'Otros programas, como los másteres, pueden requerir formación previa como Técnico Superior o experiencia demostrable en el sector' — i.e. a prior Técnico Superior/HND or demonstrable industry experience, with no bridging-credit mechanism. A 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree is not the stated entry route and no credit-recognition scheme is published.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND — the site advertises only rolling 'Inscripciones abiertas'; no dated application window for any course year was readable.
notes: TECHNICAL BLOCKER, flag for a human: cev.com serves a JavaScript shell. Four fetches (cev.com/master-en-produccion-musical/, www.cev.com/master-en-produccion-musical/, www.cev.com/curso/master-en-produccion-musical/, www.cev.com/ca/master-en-produccio-musical/) all returned the generic site chrome instead of the programme detail, so ECTS, price, modality, language and dates could not be established from the primary source. This programme needs a human to open the page in a normal browser. The official-status finding does NOT depend on that blocker: it rests on CEV's institutional type and on the absence of any RUCT row, both independently checkable. Programme appears to exist and run, but as a private certificate.

Add apertura de expediente académico 59.10 EUR and expedición del título de máster 176.00 EUR when applicable. complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT, 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 — no bridging credits built into the title). Applicant level: NOT FOUND — no complementos statement was readable on the UCA ESI or UGR programme pages, and no credit-recognition / advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS entrant was found. application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. Published Distrito Único Andaluz calendar for curso 2026/2027 (recorded as 2026-27, NOT shifted forward) — this is the single admissions channel for all Andalusian public universities: FASE 1, reserved for ESTUDIANTES EXTRANJEROS, solicitudes 13–29 January 2026, adjudicaciones 19 Feb / 12 Mar / 9 Apr 2026; FASE 2 (españoles y extranjeros) solicitudes 17–26 June 2026, 1ª adjudicación 22 July 2026, 2ª adjudicación 14 September 2026; FASE 3 solicitudes 8–15 September 2026. Applications go through a single DUA form listing up to six masters in binding order of preference (https://lajunta.es/portaldua).
notes: RUCT/ministry code 4314325 confirmed on UGR's own catalogue page ('Código del ministerio: 4314325', 'Curso 2026/2027', internal code MA8/56/1) — i.e. confirmed from the university's page, not only from the register, and the page is already published for 2026/2027, so the title is running. Specialisations are split by campus: Acústica Arquitectónica at Granada, Acústica Ambiental at Cádiz. STRATEGIC NOTE for a non-EU applicant: Andalucía runs a dedicated FASE 1 for foreign students roughly seven months before the ordinary round — for a September 2027 intake the equivalent window would fall in January 2027, which is early relative to most of this dataset; the exact 2027 dates are not published and are deliberately not extrapolated here.
